title: Condo Property Walkthrough Report Form
subtitle: Operational property walkthrough intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable condo property walkthrough workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a condo property walkthrough from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

sections.title: Walkthrough identity, purpose, and scope
sections.guidance: Define why and where the review occurs.

blocks.label: Property Walkthrough reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Purpose, trigger, and participants
blocks.guidance: A walkthrough purpose does not expand entry or professional authority.

blocks.label: Included areas, excluded areas, priority questions, and expected handoff
blocks.guidance: Make scope boundaries visible before observations begin.

fields.label: Authorized scope, exclusions, requested observations, known limits, and receiving decision owner

sections.title: Access, safety, resident impact, and evidence

blocks.label: Pre-walkthrough preparation
blocks.guidance: Do not enter or test beyond authorization, training, equipment, or safe access.
items: Authorized scope, entry basis, notice, and participants confirmed
Prior findings, work orders, maps, and equipment references linked
Weather, lighting, utility, occupancy, and access conditions recorded
Required personal protective or specialist support is routed
Resident, tenant, guest, employee, or public impact is considered
Photo plan excludes people, personal records, credentials, and unrelated belongings
Unsafe, locked, concealed, elevated, or specialist-only areas are excluded
Emergency and stop-work contacts are available

blocks.label: Immediate condition screen
blocks.guidance: Stop and use the established emergency or specialist route when conditions exceed authority.
items: Fire, smoke, gas, electrical, structural, or active life-safety concern
Water, sewage, sanitation, moisture, or environmental concern
Security, broken entry, glazing, stair, rail, or fall concern
Essential utility, ventilation, temperature, or equipment outage
Access route, elevator, door, lighting, or communication concern
Condition may affect another unit, suite, room, lot, or public area
Area requires restriction, emergency response, or specialist control
No immediate condition identified during the visible walkthrough

blocks.label: Walkthrough conditions and evidence
blocks.guidance: Use stable evidence references and document unavailable areas.

blocks.label: Immediate control, area restriction, notice, and escalation
blocks.guidance: Priority supports response routing and does not establish code or legal status.

fields.label: Condition, action taken, people notified, current restriction, owner, due point, and specialist route

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This property walkthrough record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

sections.title: Site, exterior, common area, and system observations
sections.guidance: Record visible condition by exact location.

blocks.label: Site, access, exterior, and envelope observations
blocks.guidance: Consider circulation, drainage, lighting, waste, grounds, walls, roofline, doors, windows, and exterior equipment as applicable.

blocks.label: Interior, common-area, and visible-system observations
blocks.guidance: A basic observation does not certify fire, electrical, mechanical, environmental, accessibility, or other compliance.

blocks.label: Operational areas reviewed
blocks.guidance: Check only areas actually reviewed and describe exclusions.
items: Entry, exit, circulation, parking, loading, or mobility routes
Lighting, signage, doors, windows, stairs, rails, and surfaces
Water, drainage, sanitation, waste, moisture, and pest indicators
Heating, cooling, ventilation, plumbing, and electrical observations
Alarm, sprinkler, extinguisher, call, or emergency-device presence
Laundry, storage, mail, amenity, service, or equipment areas
Landscaping, fence, gate, play, yard, or outdoor-use areas
Closed, inaccessible, unsafe, tenant-controlled, or specialist-only areas

blocks.label: Obstructed, inaccessible, weather-limited, or specialist-only observations
blocks.guidance: A limitation cannot be recorded as a passing condition.

fields.label: Area, limitation, risk control, evidence gap, responsible owner, due point, and follow-up method

sections.title: Condo context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Condo workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Unit, limited-common, and common-element boundaries are identified
Lobby, corridor, stairs, elevator, garage, and amenities are sampled
Roof, facade, drainage, and building-system observations are routed
Association, manager, owner, and vendor responsibilities are separated
Authorized unit entry is documented independently from common-area access
Reserve, project, or legal conclusions are outside this walkthrough
Common-element findings link to association action references
Reinspection records both physical result and stakeholder handoff

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Condo coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer. For a condominium walkthrough, identify unit, limited-common, and common-element boundaries before observing the lobby, corridor, stairs, elevator, garage, storage, amenities, facade, roof, drainage, and building systems. Document authorized unit entry separately from common-area access. Route each finding to the association, manager, owner, or vendor without making reserve, master-policy, project, code, architectural, or governing-document conclusions, and link reinspection to the appropriate association action record.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

blocks.label: Prioritized finding register
blocks.guidance: Use emergency, urgent, planned, or monitor only as locally defined routing priorities.

blocks.label: Work order, project, estimate, or specialist-review authorization
blocks.guidance: Do not authorize regulated, licensed, invasive, or specialist work beyond documented authority.

blocks.label: Report and action-plan review
blocks.guidance: Report approval confirms operational routing, not professional certification.

blocks.label: Deferred item, budget constraint, disputed fact, or escalation
blocks.guidance: A deferred item must retain a current control and accountable review date.

fields.label: Finding, current control, reason, authorized reviewer, owner, due point, and planned disposition

sections.title: Communication, verification, and closeout
sections.guidance: Verify action and disclose remaining limits.

blocks.label: Owner, resident, tenant, staff, and vendor communication
blocks.guidance: Share only information needed for the recipient's action.

blocks.label: Completed action and reinspection verification
blocks.guidance: Verification should match the original finding and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Report closeout verification
blocks.guidance: The walkthrough remains an operational record, not a specialist inspection.
items: Every immediate condition has a documented disposition
Every finding links to evidence and an action or monitoring decision
Affected stakeholders received necessary notice or instruction
Completed work was verified within the reviewer's authority
Deferred and unresolved work retains controls, owners, and dates
Specialist, legal, accessibility, or compliance routes remain linked
Photos and records use approved privacy and retention controls
Final report, limitations, and reopen route were handed off

blocks.label: Final outcome and handoff
blocks.guidance: Do not mark closed while a required immediate action lacks disposition.

blocks.label: Report preparation and qualified closeout review
blocks.guidance: Signatures confirm preparation and operational review; they do not certify code, engineering, environmental, accessibility, fire, or legal compliance.
